summary: Physical Tang Primer run of the morph fabric's systolic personality: reconfiguration, job latency, and an on-core reference over the same operands

correctness.method: The board checked every element against an on-core reference and printed 'role morph: PASS (scalar, SIMT, systolic on one fabric; descriptors confined)'. The digest is the same concatenated personality output the Verilator bench produces; the board program verifies the identical values element-by-element and halts non-zero on any mismatch.

org.atomix.metric.switch-latency.method: 361 management-CPU cycles at 25 MHz to write the 13-word genome plus NITEMS. On-board reconfiguration only; it excludes any host transfer of the genome.

org.atomix.metric.configuration-transfer.method: Wire time for the same 52-byte genome if it were delivered over the 921600-baud host UART rather than written locally. Not measured over the wire in this run.

org.atomix.metric.execute-cycles.method: Doorbell to observed completion, including the status polling the management CPU actually performs.

org.atomix.metric.total-cycles.method: Reconfiguration plus job latency for one personality change and run.

org.atomix.metric.clock-frequency.method: nextpnr-himbaechel GW5A-25A place-and-route at the 25 MHz board constraint

org.atomix.metric.configuration-bytes.method: The genome is 13 words; a personality change writes only these plus NITEMS.

org.atomix.physical-run.uart_transcript: role morph: PASS (scalar, SIMT, systolic on one fabric; descriptors confined)
org.atomix.physical-run.note: The on-core reference reads the same operands from volatile RAM arrays so -O2 cannot fold the loop; the scalar reference cross-validates at 3,732 cycles against the gpu-compute payload.
